notes.subject: toktok nogut long mi
notes.rationale: ישטנוני — em i wok bilong Satan, tok nogut, pasin bilong akusim man; mas i no glasim

notes.subject: תחת ... תחת
notes.rationale: tupela 'תחת' — wanpela long 'ples bilong', wanpela long 'long wanem'; rong-imijing i lus long tanim tok

notes.subject: רדופי
notes.rationale: 'ol i biruarim mi' (radaf) o 'long wanem mi bihainim' — KJV 'because I follow that which is good'

translation: Na ol i save givim bikpela samting nogut long ples bilong gutpela samting, ol i toktok nogut long mi, long wanem mi bihainim gutpela pasin.

tokens.gloss: ol i toktok nogut long mi
